newsitem.title: USA: NATO commander says Albania not "another Bosnia".
newsitem.headline: NATO commander says Albania not "another Bosnia".

text.p: NATO commander Gen. George Joulwan said on Wednesday he did not believe Albania would become another country racked by ethnic warfare country as Bosnia has been.
Asked at a U.S. House of Representatives National Security Committee hearing if Albania was rapidly becoming the next Bosnia for the United States, Joulwan said "no."

He said the violence in Bosnia involved only the Albanian people, not warring ethnic groups like those which fought in Bosnia before the 1995 Dayton peace agreement was reached and a NATO peacekeeping force restored calm.
In Albania, "It's a lawlessness, it's criminal, it's a very very poor country but I don't see it evolving into another Bosnia," Joulwan said.
